items.title: Monday briefing: What could Andy Burnham’s reset mean for the UK?
items.summary: In today’s newsletter: The prime minister has reopened the debate over a future relationship with a changed EU – as the bloc faces the rise of the far right, a protectionist economic agenda and growing defence ambitions Good morning. Nobody really wants to think about Brexit any more, save for the original Brexiters, who seem delighted that Andy Burnham’s “reset” with the EU has given them an excuse to get the old gang back together. But arguments about whether the UK should rejoin the EU will reignite in parliament this week, as Burnham briefs MPs on the deal he agreed on Friday. That deal wasn’t so much a victory as the culmination of Keir Starmer’s incrementalist approach to UK-EU relations. Its core agreements haven’t been ratified by member states yet, and the EU won’t sign them off until Britain resolves a dispute over tuition fees for European students. Burnham is apparently “determined” to take the UK back into the EU, but don’t expect any progress on that before the next general election. items.summary: South Korea’s rights watchdog said on Monday it recommended that an immigration detention centre minimise restrictions on detainees’ freedom of communication, after it found that a facility violated a detainee’s right to pursue happiness by not allowing a video call with a dying father. The National Human Rights Commission of Korea, which made the recommendation last week, called on the centre to guarantee that detainees can use their personal mobile phones to the extent necessary in urgent and...

items.titleZh: 韩国人权机构批评拘留中心：被拘留者被拒绝与垂死父亲进行最后通话

items.title: Theresa May’s blast from the past calls Tories back to their unhappy place | Peter Walker
items.summary: Conservatives may instinctively want to push back against closer EU ties, but they have to train their focus elsewhere Anyone who accidentally switched to BBC One at about 9.45am on Sunday to be greeted by Theresa May awkwardly espousing the virtues of Brexit could have been forgiven for thinking they had woken up in around 2018 – and not being especially pleased at the idea. This is one of the problems now facing May’s party. For all that it is a reflex action for Conservatives to push back against closer ties with the EU, Andy Burnham’s decision to pursue such a course plunges them back into their own unhappy place. items.title: Why Hong Kong’s Fine Art Asia fair has moved to Shenzhen after 20 years
items.summary: Hong Kong’s longest-running art and antiques fair, Fine Art Asia (FAA), is relocating to Shenzhen for its upcoming 2026 edition, which will take place from November 26 to 29, with its founder citing a sharp market downturn in his home city as one of the reasons behind the decision. items.whyImportant: 这一变动反映了区域艺术市场重心的潜在转移以及香港文化产业面临的经济挑战。

items.title: Tencent touts latest AI model Hy4’s performance on independent safety assessments

items.summaryZh: 霍尔木兹海峡发生油轮起火事件。伊朗方面警告称，其敌对势力正试图煽动国内动乱。
items.whyImportant: 该事件加剧了波斯湾地区的紧张局势，并可能对全球能源供应安全产生重大影响。

items.title: Fewer than half in UK will pay TV licence fee within a decade, report warns
items.summary: Analysis for thinktank points to cycle of falling income leading to lower spending on content in ‘spiral of decline’ Fewer than half of households in Britain will pay the BBC’s licence within a decade, according to analysis that warns that the broadcaster’s funding is locked in a “spiral of decline”. With senior BBC figures concerned about the accelerating fall in licence fee sales, the independent projections also warn that the proportion of households paying the levy will further decline to less than a third by 2037-38 should the government persist with the corporation’s current funding model. items.titleZh: 报告警告：十年内英国支付电视许可费的家庭将不足半数

items.whyImportant: 该趋势对BBC的长期财务可持续性及公共广播模式构成了严峻挑战。

items.title: Burnham not ‘backtracking’ on creating closer links with EU, officials say
items.summary: Government wants to let trade deal ‘breathe a bit’, insiders say, after speculation No 10 is dialling back ambitions Andy Burnham is not backtracking or delaying his ambitions to create even closer links with the EU in the wake of a landmark summit in Brussels, the Guardian has been told, after signs of an apparent slowdown in the timetable. The prime minister has promised to set out options for the UK’s long-term relationship with the EU, including the possibility of rejoining, saying last week that these would be outlined later in the year. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 官员称伯纳姆并未在与欧盟建立更紧密联系的问题上“退缩”
items.summaryZh: 尽管外界猜测英国政府正在放缓与欧盟建立更紧密关系的步伐，但相关人士表示，安迪·伯纳姆并未改变其目标。政府目前希望让贸易协议有更多缓冲空间，并承诺将在今年晚些时候阐述英国与欧盟长期关系的选项。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了英国政府在处理脱欧后对欧关系时，需要在政治雄心与实际贸易执行之间寻求平衡。

items.title: Hong Kong names former lawmaker Chan Kin-por as Hospital Authority chairman
items.summary: Former Hong Kong lawmaker and veteran insurance executive Chan Kin-por has pledged to improve management and retain staff as he prepares to become chairman of the Hospital Authority, describing the role as an “immense responsibility”. The government announced on Monday that Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu had appointed Chan to lead the body that manages the city’s 44 public hospitals and institutions for a two-year term starting on December 1. items.titleZh: 香港委任前立法会议员陈健波为医院管理局主席
items.summaryZh: 香港政府宣布委任资深保险业高管、前立法会议员陈健波为医院管理局主席，任期两年，自12月1日起生效。陈健波承诺将致力于改善管理并留住医疗人才，接替即将卸任的范鸿龄。

items.title: New 19-month low: Hong Kong stocks plunge as AI sell-off spreads to Asia

The Hang Seng Tech Index, which tracks the city’s largest technology companies, fell as much as 3 per cent to below 3,400 points, taking its loss for the year to more than a third. items.titleZh: 创19个月新低：人工智能抛售潮蔓延至亚洲，港股大幅下挫
items.summaryZh: 受美国人工智能股票抛售潮影响，香港股市周一跌至19个月以来的最低点，科技股领跌。恒生科技指数盘中一度下跌3%，年内跌幅已超过三分之一。
items.whyImportant: 全球科技板块的波动正显著加剧香港资本市场的下行压力。

items.title: Tai Po fire survivors battle grief, fear and trauma as first anniversary nears
items.summary: A year after the deadly Wang Fuk Court blaze in Hong Kong, Hilary Lau has developed certain habits born out of the tragedy. The 49-year-old who lost both his parents can fall asleep only under a fire-resistant blanket and keeps extra fire extinguishers at his flat in Kong Ha Wai Village, a transitional housing project in Yuen Long. items.titleZh: 大埔火灾幸存者在周年纪念临近之际与悲伤、恐惧和创伤抗争
items.summaryZh: 香港宏福苑致命火灾发生近一年后，幸存者仍深受心理创伤影响，表现出对火灾的极度恐惧和防御性行为。许多受害者在失去亲人后，至今难以走出阴影，生活习惯也因创伤而发生改变。
